Deploy</div><div><div><h4>Deploy on Zeit Now, Netlify, Heroku or your favorite hosting platform</h4></div><div><p>We take care of hosting and scaling the publishing tools. All you have to do is host the website, but you can choose whichever hosting platform you prefer. </p></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></section><div class="carousel pv8"><div class="grid-container"><div class="grid-x"><div class="cell small-12 medium-10 medium-offset-1 title pb6"><div><h2>Use your technology of choice</h2></div><div><p>Every framework has its own properties and advantages, fast rendering, SEO, ease of deployment or progressive enhancement. Prismic integrates with every framework so that you can choose the best fit for your project</p></div></div></div><div class="slider"><div class="slick-slider slick-initialized" dir="ltr"><div class="slick-list"><div class="slick-track" style="width: 1775px; opacity: 1; transform: translate3d(0px, 0px, 0px);"><div aria-hidden="false" class="slick-slide slick-active slick-current" data-index="0" style="outline: none; width: 355px;" tabindex="-1"><div><div class="card ph4 pt6 pb5" style="width:100%;display:inline-block" tabindex="-1"><img src="https://images.prismic.io/prismic-website%2F4c9383b6-c51e-42f7-a28c-b5e689ec87b9_next-js-logo.com.svg?auto=compress,format"/><div><h6>Next.js</h6></div><div><p>Next is a great choice if you are familiar with React but want static-site generation, server-side rendering, and Serverless deployment. </p></div><a href="https://prismic.io/docs/reactjs/getting-started/prismic-nextjs">Read more</a></div></div></div><div aria-hidden="false" class="slick-slide slick-active" data-index="1" style="outline: none; width: 355px;" tabindex="-1"><div><div class="card ph4 pt6 pb5" style="width:100%;display:inline-block" tabindex="-1"><img src="https://images.prismic.io/prismic-website%2F92cdb2df-5cb7-44b0-8542-738892018ca3_gatsby-icon.svg?auto=compress,format"/><div><h6>Gatsby</h6></div><div><p>Gatsby is an extremely popular static site generator based on React. It offers a great developer experience thanks to a huge selection of plugins. </p></div><a href="https://prismic.io/gatsbyjs">Read more</a></div></div></div><div aria-hidden="false" class="slick-slide slick-active" data-index="2" style="outline: none; width: 355px;" tabindex="-1"><div><div class="card ph4 pt6 pb5" style="width:100%;display:inline-block" tabindex="-1"><img src="https://images.prismic.io/prismic-website%2F9330681e-e9b4-4245-b7ac-4c3210af638f_logo-nuxts.svg?auto=compress,format"/><div><h6>Nuxt.js</h6></div><div><p>Great for SEO, Nuxt is a good choice if you're familiar with Vue and you are looking for static-site generation and server-side rendering.  </p></div><a href="https://prismic.io/docs/vuejs/getting-started/prismic-nuxt">Read more</a></div></div></div><div aria-hidden="true" class="slick-slide" data-index="3" style="outline: none; width: 355px;" tabindex="-1"><div><div class="card ph4 pt6 pb5" style="width:100%;display:inline-block" tabindex="-1"><img src="https://images.prismic.io/prismic-website%2F879440e3-b8ea-46e7-a69e-bdc3b52a83f4_react-icon.svg?auto=compress,format"/><div><h6>React.js</h6></div><div><p>Widely used with a large community and ecosystem. React is a great fit for any projects where client-side rendering is necessary. </p></div><a href="https://prismic.io/docs/reactjs/getting-started/getting-started-from-scratch">Read more</a></div></div></div><div aria-hidden="true" class="slick-slide" data-index="4" style="outline: none; width: 355px;" tabindex="-1"><div><div class="card ph4 pt6 pb5" style="width:100%;display:inline-block" tabindex="-1"><img src="https://images.prismic.io/prismic-website%2F60569575-6269-4633-a42e-d7f0c1ded9f5_vue-icon.svg?auto=compress,format"/><div><h6>Vue.js</h6></div><div><p>Vue is easy to use and is a great way to start a component framework. It also offers a huge doc library and a growing ecosystem. </p></div><a href="https://prismic.io/docs/vuejs/getting-started/with-the-vuejs-starter">Read more</a></div></div></div></div></div><ul class="slick-dots" style="display:block"><li class="slick-active"><button>1</button></li><li class=""><button>2</button></li><li class=""><button>3</button></li><li class=""><button>4</button></li></ul></div></div></div></div><section id="benefits-section"><div class="grid-container"><div class="grid-x grid-margin-x"><div class="cell small-12 pb4"><div><h2>Why we think Prismic is good for developers </h2></div></div><div class="cell small-12 medium-4 pa5"><div class="feature"><img src="https://images.prismic.io/prismic-website%2F4e288d2e-66cd-4209-9ada-fbfb6f1c19c1_api.svg?auto=compress,format"/><div><h4>API to fetch content</h4></div><div><p>Unlike a traditional CMS, an API-based approach is much simpler and more secure. This includes options for REST, GraphQL, and SDKs that help our users to make the most of Prismic. </p></div></div></div><div class="cell small-12 medium-4 pa5"><div class="feature"><img src="https://images.prismic.io/prismic-website%2F4080f213-f9e0-47f1-ae57-1d26874f1a08_setup.svg?auto=compress,format"/><div><h4>No maintenance or server setup </h4></div><div><p>We offer a high-level SLAs, scalability, and a global CDN.
